"Crocodile Breeding Farm in Malayer ☠️  😰 "

"🔹 The crocodile breeding farm in Malayer, Hamadan Province, began its operations in 1397 (2018–2019), making it one of the country’s distinctive economic capacities."

"🔹 This complex, in addition to its tourism appeal, has unique added value, as crocodile skin, meat, blood, and teeth have high economic value. 🤬
